gloss: the strongest person; the most powerful

definitions.gloss: the strongest person; the most powerful individual
definitions.explanation: The person who is the strongest or most powerful in a given group, field, or competition. Frequently used in gaming, martial arts, sports, and fiction.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}がこの{大会|たいかい}の{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is the strongest in this tournament.

examples.japanese: {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}を{決|き}めるトーナメントが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The tournament to decide the strongest has begun.

examples.japanese: {歴代|れきだい}の{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}たちが{一堂|いちどう}に{会|かい}する{夢|ゆめ}のような{大会|たいかい}だった。
examples.english: It was a dream-like tournament where the strongest competitors of all time gathered in one place.

notes:
A compound of {最強|さいきょう} (strongest) and {者|しゃ} (person). This word is heavily used in competitive and entertainment contexts: fighting games, anime, martial arts, and sports discussions.

The concept of {最強者|さいきょうしゃ} is a recurring theme in Japanese popular culture, from battle manga to competitive gaming. Characters described as the {最強者|さいきょうしゃ} often serve as the ultimate challenge or final boss.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}を{決|き}める: to determine the strongest
- {歴代|れきだい}{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}: the strongest of all time
- {真|しん}の{最強者|さいきょうしゃ}: the true strongest
- {最強者|さいきょうしゃ}に{挑|いど}む: to challenge the strongest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最強|さいきょう}: strongest — the adjective/noun without the person suffix
- {王者|おうじゃ}: champion, champion title holder — emphasizes holding a title or throne
- {覇者|はしゃ}: champion, victor — emphasizes dominance through winning a competition
- {達人|たつじん}: master, expert — emphasizes skill and mastery rather than raw power
